title: Instrumental seamless loop, 16-bit retro RPG soundtrack with Victorian chamber colour. Warm harpsichord, celesta, and woodwinds playing the main Wonderland motif in a gentle 3/4 waltz at 96 BPM. Nostalgic, cosy, storybook mood with plucked strings and soft Chiptune arpeggios.
rabbit_hole: Instrumental seamless loop, 16-bit cosy retro soundtrack with Victorian parlor flair. Gentle flute and harpsichord play the main motif at 90 BPM, shifting from sunny pastoral strings to subterranean echoing celesta and pizzicato bass. Curious, dreamy, slightly mysterious mood.
rabbit_house: Instrumental seamless loop, 16-bit retro RPG style with Victorian English folk colour. Jaunty oboe, bassoon, and harpsichord carry the main motif at 108 BPM, transitioning into lazy, hazy sitar-like chiptune and low clarinet for the mushroom wood. Cosy, whimsical, eccentric mood.
duchess_wood: Instrumental seamless loop, 16-bit retro soundtrack with quirky Victorian music-hall colour. Off-kilter waltz at 114 BPM featuring harpsichord, playful clarinet, and teacup percussion, weaving the main motif through mysterious vibraphone chords and bustling bassoon. Cosy, madcap, mischievous mood.
queens_garden: Instrumental seamless loop, 16-bit retro game style with Victorian baroque pomp. Pompous brass, snare, and harpsichord play a regal march variation of the main motif at 112 BPM, softening into wistful seaside strings and flute. Grand, comical, yet cosy mood.
